description: Test suite for AppState remote configuration synchronization, focusing on token handling and mode changes.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigSetsTrimmedToken
methods.description: Tests that the remote gateway configuration correctly trims whitespace from the token.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsTokenWhenBlank
methods.description: Tests that an empty or whitespace token results in the token being cleared.

methods.name: syncedGatewayRootPreservesObjectTokenAcrossModeAndTransportChangesWhenUntouched
methods.description: Ensures that object tokens in the gateway root are preserved across mode and transport changes when untouched.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigReplacesObjectTokenWhenUserEntersPlaintext
methods.description: Checks that a plaintext token replaces the secret reference object token correctly.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsObjectTokenOnlyAfterExplicitEdit
methods.description: Verifies that object tokens are preserved unless explicitly cleared or modified.
